purpose: The only GitHub Actions secrets any workflow may reference (owner decision, B10-hosted increment, 2026-09-21). Default: nothing. An unregistered secret name fails the policy check, and so does a registered name used in another workflow or another job.
rules: Each entry needs name, workflow, job, justification, approvedBy, approvedOn (YYYY-MM-DD) and expires (YYYY-MM-DD). Structural problems are fatal. Expiry is NOT fatal repository-wide: an expired registration is a scoped rejection that disables only its own job (owner decision, expiry option B). This scoped behaviour exists solely for this register; policy/osv-exceptions.json, policy/release-age-exceptions.json, policy/currency-literal-allowlist.json and policy/dependency-overrides.json keep their own semantics, where an expired entry fails the job.
